listing: Private room in sublet, $750/mo, Jan 1 - Apr 30, steps from the ION. To lock it in you need first month AND the last two months paid before you get keys ("first + last + last again" lol). Total due at signing is $2,250 on $750 rent. It's all returned or applied by the end of the term. Tour any evening. 120 Caroline St S, Waterloo.
label_rationale: Two months' rent held as deposit beyond the first month. A rent deposit cannot exceed one rental period (RTA s.106); the first/last structure is lawful only once. HOLD.
